releaseNotes: Offline-first study notes: every book of the Bible has a curated bilingual introduction, canonical passages keep a full eight-step study note even without a connection, and validated cross-references fold in from an offline index. Prompting and validation hardened to canonical book ids with USFM alias handling, notes are cached in memory so repeated opens are instant and concurrent opens share one request, and the panel always renders the note in a fixed, canonical order.
